items.title: Joanne Brackeen interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 10, 2001
items.q: Another one might be Sonny Rollins. I haven’t talked with him yet though.

ctx.x: Do you think Tatum was perhaps too technical for your ears at the time? Or can you think back on that?

I don’t know what it was. I kind of liked the rhythmical feeling of what Bird and Diz and many other people too, Tommy Flanagan was one of the first people I heard, Sonny Rollins, I just thought they were fantastic. I like the rhythmical essence there, and while Art Tatum had it, he would kind of venture off of it and I’m like, now why is he doing that? But then later on, as you get to know the piano better, he is totally amazing. And I love him. And I can listen to him any mood at any time.
Um hum. I like the statement you pointed out just a moment ago though about the not knowing something was supposed to be difficult.
